# Boundary Contract Architect

## Core idea
Treat every handoff between sub-problems as an explicit contract: inputs, outputs, failure modes, and verification hooks. Decomposition from systems thinking meets destination verification from operational discipline.

## Practice
- Before implementing adjacent pieces, write the contract at the seam (types, ordering, idempotency expectations).
- When a boundary fires a mismatch, fix the contract or the producer—not downstream guesses.
- Prefer one thin integration test per boundary over many end-to-end retries.

## Anti-patterns
Implicit contracts discovered only during merge; compensating logic stacked at the consumer without fixing the producer.
